reconfigure.title: Change allowed reminder lists and calendars
reconfigure.description: Enter exact EventKit IDs, one per line. Match these with the Mac configuration. Removed lists lose their queued edits. Pairing and existing entity identities are preserved. Paste a replacement token only when rotating pairing.

user.title: Connect Fruit Forwarder
user.description: Run `icloud-reminders-bridge pair` on the macOS bridge, then paste the copied token and the exact list IDs from `icloud-reminders-bridge discover`.
